sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law inherited from the former Anglo-French Condominium, French Civil Law influence, and customary law; unitary national statutes apply to international companies, trusts, and financial licensees)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)
OECD Inclusive Framework on BEPS and Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information participation; no comprehensive double tax agreement in force for Vanuatu

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Vanuatu Financial Transactions Reporting Act No. 27 of 2011 (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap 222]; International Trusts Act [Cap 211]; Trust Companies Act [Cap 70]; Companies Act [Cap 191]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 235]; VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines and Risk-Based Supervision Framework; directives of the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); Beneficial Ownership Register maintenance obligations introduced under amendments to the International Companies Act and administered by the VFSC Registry.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of Passport (each beneficial owner, settlor, protector, and trustee director)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Notary Public in the Country of Origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the notary certificate must be authenticated by the competent Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin state and then legalized by a Vanuatu High Commission, Embassy, or Consulate having consular competence)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's Reference Letter and Financial Standing Certificate (source of wealth and source of funds for the trust settlement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain (Notary attestation of bank signature, origin-state Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, then legalization by Vanuatu consular mission); notarized bank letter accepted by VFSC licensed agents as standard market practice

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Power of Attorney or Corporate Resolutions of underlying corporate settlor (if the settlor is a juridical person)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Company Registry or Notary Public in the Corporate Settlor's Jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the origin state is a Contracting Party; otherwise full Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention, so apostilles from other states are not automatically recognized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Trust Deed / Settlement Deed and Discretionary Asset Protection Trust Structure Chart
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Settlor and the proposed Vanuatu Licensed Trust Company (Trustee)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Document executed under the International Trusts Act [Cap 211]; signatures witnessed by a Vanuatu notary or commissioner for oaths; consular legalization only where the trust deed is executed outside Vanuatu

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under Part 3 of the Financial Transactions Reporting Act No. 27 of 2011, including enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (settlor, protector, discretionary beneficiaries, trustee directors); mandatory screening of all UBOs and trust parties against the UN Security Council sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions list, UK Sanctions List, and VFIU/VFSC public advisories; ongoing transaction monitoring and annual UBO refresh; for high-risk discretionary asset protection trust structures with fiduciary banking rails, 100% sanctions and PEP screening is required before name clearance, and enhanced scrutiny applies to any nexus with sanctioned jurisdictions or penalized tax jurisdictions.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_and_aml_profiling_notes: Vanuatu maintains a confidential beneficial ownership register accessible by VFIU, VFSC, and other competent authorities; the register is not open to public inspection; licensed registered agents must hold and verify UBO files internally.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Registry Services — official website vfsc.vu; online name availability search and reservation processed through the VFSC Company Registry Portal or authorized VFSC-licensed registered agents
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Constitution of Vanuatu establishes Bislama, English, and French as official languages; company names must be submitted in Latin/Roman script in English or French; Bislama names and transliterated foreign names are permitted only when rendered in Roman characters; the name must be distinguishable from existing registered or reserved names and must not contain symbols or scripts outside the Latin alphabet; an International Company must include a distinctive suffix such as Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, or the French equivalent (Société Anonyme or abbreviated forms), and the name must not be obscene, offensive, or contrary to public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection or conditional approval by the VFSC Registrar, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written Notice of Appeal / Administrative Review Application to the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection decision, accompanied by (i) the original name search result, (ii) a letter of no-objection from the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu or the relevant competent ministry for any prohibited or sensitive token, (iii) the reserved-name fee, and (iv) a certificate of incorporation of the proposed entity if already drafted; the Registrar must issue a decision within 5–10 business days; if the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Judicial Review legislation; alternatively, the applicant may promptly re-file with a substituted distinctive word and re-pay the name search and reservation fee.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.statutory_name_clearance_protocol_notes: For the target ISIC 6430 discretionary asset protection trust scope, any proposed name containing 'Trust', 'Fiduciary', 'Trustee', 'Bank', or 'Financial' will require a VFSC license under the Trust Companies Act [Cap 70] or prior ministerial approval; VFSC will not accept a name implying the carrying on of licensable trust business unless the applicant holds or has applied for the corresponding license.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is NOT permitted as the sole registered office for an International Company conducting fiduciary administration of trusts; the International Companies Act [Cap 222] requires a physical registered office in Vanuatu situated at the premises of a licensed registered agent, and the Trust Companies Act [Cap 70] requires the licensed trust company to maintain substantive management and records in Vanuatu; a virtual or mail-forwarding-only address is acceptable only as supplementary administrative support in addition to the physical on-island registered office of the licensed agent or licensed trust company.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 70–80% annual probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection for licensed trust / fiduciary entities under the VFSC Risk-Based Supervision program (2023–2025 assessment cycle); the VFSC conducts unannounced site visits, inspection of trust books and records, UBO register verification, and AML/CFT compliance audits; a discretionary asset protection trust with high-risk banking rails and Swift wire settlement will be treated as a high-priority inspection target, with a quantifiable 30-day risk window for a targeted inspection if any UBO, PEP, or sanctions red flag arises; passive International Companies not carrying on licensable trust activity face a lower inspection likelihood of 20–30%.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.registered_office_and_commercial_substan: The licensed registered agent and trust company must demonstrate commercial substance through physical premises, local resident directors or managers, and custody of statutory records and beneficial ownership information in Vanuatu; off-shore virtual substance is contrary to VFSC supervisory expectations and FATF-aligned AML/CFT outcomes.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name availability search and reservation fee (International Companies Act [Cap 222] Fee Schedule)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per VFSC fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle (passport certified copy, banker's reference, source of wealth, power of attorney or corporate resolutions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public, origin-state Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Vanuatu consular mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark plus statutory notarial and consular tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO piercing file, PEP screening, OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening, and risk rating report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / compliance service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per discretionary trust structure covering settlor, protector, beneficiaries, and trustee directors

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC license application fee for Trust Company under Trust Companies Act [Cap 70] (first-year application filing for ISIC 6430 fiduciary administration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory license tariff and sector benchmark for trust-license applicants

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation certificate and registration filing fee for the International Company (International Companies Act [Cap 222])
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per International Companies Act Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and physical registered office — first-month deposit toward annual fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed agent services in Vanuatu

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Trust registration fee under International Trusts Act [Cap 211] (filing and stamp fees)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under International Trusts Act [Cap 211] and applicable fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and facilitation of consular legalization chain (secure document transmission to Vanuatu)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed courier provider / corporate services agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for international secure courier services

stage_1.pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd_no: Total estimated Stage 1 budget is approximately USD 8,995, exclusive of subsequent annual trustee, audit, and ongoing AML/CFT monitoring fees; all figures are pre-incorporation estimates and subject to VFSC tariff changes and fluctuating consular legalization fees.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Laws of Vanuatu, Cap 222), ss. 5–8 (incorporation), s. 15 (registered office), s. 26 (share capital), s. 31 (directors); Trust Companies Act 2005 (Act No. 14 of 2005), ss. 9–12 (trust company licensing); Financial Services Commission Act 1993 (establishment of VFSC).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with executed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association, filed through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The International Companies Act 1992 prescribes no minimum paid-up capital for an International Company limited by shares. However, the VFSC Trust Company Licence requires the applicant to demonstrate adequate unimpaired net assets (typically at least VT 2,000,000 or an equivalent bank guarantee acceptable to the VFSC), held in a segregated fiduciary escrow account at a VFSC-licensed bank before fiduciary administration of discretionary asset-protection spendthrift trusts may commence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by unanimous written consent of the first subscriber/shareholder of [COMPANY NAME] (the Company), an International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1992 (Vanuatu): 1. SUBSCRIPTION: The allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares at USD 1.00 each to the subscriber is ratified; subscription consideration is deemed paid into the Company's escrow account. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office is fixed at [Registered Agent address], Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the VFSC-licensed registered agent is appointed agent for service of process. 3. OFFICERS: [Name] is appointed Director and [Name] Secretary, with authority to execute all incorporation follow-up filings. 4. INCIDENTAL POWERS: Officers may open bank accounts and obtain the Trust Company Licence. Adopted at Port Vila, this ____ day of ______________.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila (submitted via the secure VFSC e-filing channel through a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Name Search and Reservation Application with the VFSC through the appointed licensed agent, selecting up to three alternative corporate names. Restricted words such as 'Trust', 'Bank', 'Insurance' and 'Assurance' require prior VFSC consent. On approval, the name is reserved for a non-renewable period of 30 days.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Application form VU-IC-NA-001
Signed engagement letter of the VFSC-licensed registered agent
Certified true copy of the subscriber's or beneficial owner's passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, resubmit fresh alternative names within five business days; the standard reservation fee is credited and only a USD 20 processing shortfall is payable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent; notary public admitted to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in compliance with the International Companies Act 1992, with the objects clause expressly authorizing fiduciary administration of irrevocable discretionary offshore spendthrift trusts, the share capital clause (1,000 ordinary shares of USD 1.00) and the registered office clause. The subscriber, director and secretary execute the documents, and every page is notarized.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (executed and notarized)
Subscriber consent and declaration of beneficial ownership
Consent to act as director and consent to act as secretary
Notarized certificate of identity for each appointee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The notary or registered agent returns defective documents with a marginal correction memorandum; corrected pages are re-executed and re-notarized within three business days without additional state fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Application, Fee Payment and Statutory Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed and notarized constitutional documents together with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company) through the licensed agent. Pay the state incorporation fee of USD 250 plus VFSC processing levy via the official treasury payment gateway. The Registrar conducts a legal-form and completeness review and issues a registration number upon acceptance.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (duplicate original)
Registered office consent from the licensed agent
Consents of first director and secretary
Official treasury receipt of the USD 250 filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition letter, file the responsive declaration and corrected schedule within 14 days; late or unanswered requisitions attract a USD 50 reinstatement fee and re-entry into the queue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Post-Incorporation Governance and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry; first board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon clearance, collect the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the official seal, registration number and date. The board must then adopt the first board resolution, allot and issue share certificates, maintain the register of members, directors and secretary, open bank and fiduciary trust accounts, and file the registered office notification within 21 days.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
First board resolution (original minutes)
Share certificates and register of members
Register of directors and secretary
Registered office notification form IC-RO-1
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Material clerical errors in the certificate are corrected by filing declaration VU-IC-CON-01; the rectified certificate issues within three business days, free of state fee where the error originated with the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: AML/CFT Compliance Programme Adoption and Fiduciary Licence Fit-and-Proper Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Licensing and Supervision Division; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before trust operations commence, adopt a documented Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) programme meeting the standards of the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2024 and VFSC circulars, appoint an AML compliance officer, and file the fit-and-proper declarations required for the Trust Company Licence application.
required_dossiers: AML/CFT policy and procedure manual
Entity-level risk assessment for high-risk discretionary trust business
Customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence protocols
Appointment letter of AML compliance officer
Fit-and-proper personal questionnaires for shareholders, directors and senior managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The VFSC returns the package with inspection observations; the applicant must cure all observations and resubmit within 10 business days, failing which the licence application fee is partially forfeited (USD 100) and a new application docket is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Licensing and Supervision Division; Ministry of Internal Affairs (fire and building permits)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trust Company Licence issued under the Trust Companies Act 2005 (Act No. 14 of 2005), authorizing the fiduciary administration of irrevocable discretionary offshore asset-protection spendthrift trusts

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'Office and Administration Use' – not a prescribed activity under the Environmental Protection Act 2003; a simplified Environmental Registration certificate suffices for leased professional office premises, and no Environmental Impact Assessment or Environmental Impact Statement is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or process emissions arise from fiduciary office operations. Sanitary effluent must meet Port Vila municipal sewer discharge standards (trade waste limits) where connected; otherwise, septic systems must comply with DEPC siting requirements. Confidential paper and e-waste must be handled under the Waste Management Regulations; any standby generator must satisfy diesel emission and noise standards of the DEPC.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services (Ministry of Internal Affairs) including means-of-escape and extinguisher compliance; structural load inspection and building compliance certificate from the Public Works Department for the leased premises; workplace registration and risk assessment under the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015, with first-aid and emergency response arrangements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (VDCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Incorporate the International Company (IC) with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act 1994 (CAP 222) and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation. 2. No income tax registration exists because Vanuatu has not levied income tax since 1987. 3. Apply for VAT registration on Form VAT R1 with the VDCIR Commissioner only where taxable turnover in Vanuatu reaches VT 5,000,000 (approx. USD 42,000) within any 12-month period; a fiduciary IC rendering services exclusively to non-resident settlors and beneficiaries is ordinarily outside the VAT nexus and therefore not required to register. 4. If the IC elects voluntary VAT registration, the VDCIR issues a TIN-based VAT registration number. 5. No municipal business license is required for an IC exercising its statutory exemption under s.6 of the IC Act, unless local physical operations are separately established.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (a) Voluntary VAT registration election under s.11(3) of the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 for persons below the VT 5,000,000 threshold; (b) Election under VAT Act s.7(2) to zero-rate cross-border supplies of fiduciary services to non-residents, subject to contemporaneous documentary substantiation; (c) IC Act s.6 statutory exemption from all present and future Vanuatu taxes, stamp duties, and exchange-control regulations, with a 20-year non-impairment guarantee from incorporation date; no check-the-box election exists because the IC tax-exempt status is automatic and non-elective; hybrid-mismatch elections are inapplicable as Vanuatu has no income tax regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (approximately USD 42,000) of taxable aggregate turnover in any consecutive 12-month period
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu is in phased deployment of electronic fiscal devices (EFDs) under the VAT (Electronic Fiscal Devices) Regulations 2022; VAT-registered taxpayers must use certified EFD software and transmit transaction data to the Vanuatu Revenue Management System (VRMS); full real-time fiscal clearance and mandatory digital stamping are not yet universally operational; ASYCUDA World is used for customs declarations and import tax stamping; an IC with no Vanuatu taxable supplies and no VAT registration has no e-invoicing transmission obligation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under s.7 of the VAT Act 1998 to: (a) goods exported from Vanuatu; (b) services supplied to a non-resident where the benefit is consumed wholly outside Vanuatu, including cross-border fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts, trust accounting, and asset-protection structuring performed from Vanuatu; and (c) international transport services. The IC must maintain contemporaneous evidence showing the recipient is a non-resident, the services are not consumed in Vanuatu, and the consideration is received from outside the Vanuatu VAT jurisdiction; input VAT attributable to the zero-rated supply is refundable under the normal VAT refund mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged in ASYCUDA World (for physical goods)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing export movement
Commercial Invoice describing the zero-rated fiduciary supply
Executed Fiduciary Administration Agreement with the non-resident trust settlor or trustee
Certified copy of the Discretionary Asset Protection Trust Deed evidencing governing law and situs
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT confirmation of overseas fee payment
Non-resident status declaration from the counterparty beneficiary
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No mandatory FX repatriation deadline applies because ICs are statutorily exempt from the Vanuatu Exchange Control Act under s.6 of the International Companies Act 1994; notwithstanding, abuse of export zero-rating is subject to the VAT Act penalty regime: civil penalty up to 200% of the tax shortfall on a fraudulent claim, interest at the prescribed ministerial rate on all retrospective assessments, and a 5-year assessment period (extended to 7 years for fraud or wilful default); criminal conviction for fraudulent export VAT claims may result in a fine not exceeding VT 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 7 years, plus forfeiture of wrongly refunded input credits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 322], is the sole authority for exchange control administration, monetary policy, and prudential licensing of all deposit-taking financial institutions. Exchange control is formally governed by the Exchange Control Act [CAP 71] as substantially liberalized by the Exchange Control (Amendment) Act 2006. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately supervises trust and company service providers (including the licensed trustee entity of this discretionary asset protection trust) under the Trust Companies Act [CAP 60] and the International Companies Act [CAP 222], while the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) monitors AML/CFT reporting under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) operates under a conventional pegged arrangement against an undisclosed foreign-currency composite, with the RBV managing convertibility. Vanuatu maintains full current-account convertibility and a largely liberalized capital account: since the Exchange Control (Amendment) Act 2006, prior ministerial consent for capital inflows, income remittances, and repatriations has been abolished. Non-resident beneficiaries may freely receive trust distributions without FX quota or approval. Profit remittance and capital repatriation are unrestricted for foreign parties. Practical constraints are not legal but operational: (i) banks must report balance-of-payments statistics for any single transfer above VUV 10 million (approximately USD 85,000); (ii) cash transactions above VUV 1 million trigger mandatory currency transaction reports; (iii) USD and other foreign-currency settlements rely on correspondent banks subject to OFAC screening; and (iv) FATF increased monitoring (grey-list, June 2024) has intensified enhanced due diligence on all VU legal entities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion requirement applies to foreign-currency receipts; the 2006 amendments abolished all statutory direction to convert export proceeds into VUV and likewise removed any deadline for repatriation of such proceeds. For the subject discretionary trust (which generates no trading export revenue), any incidental foreign-currency receipts may be held indefinitely in Foreign Currency Accounts (FCAs) at licensed RBV-regulated banks, subject only to record retention, OFAC/RBV screening, and aggregate reporting thresholds. Mandatory conversion ratio is zero percent.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Trust Operational Account / Settled Client Money Account
Operational Account / Foreign Currency Account (USD, AUD, EUR)
Trust Operational Account / Designated Escrow-Equivalent Trust Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of the South Pacific (BSP) – Vanuatu Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Vanuatu has no domestic EMI licensing framework for digital-only payment institutions, and leading offshore EMIs and FX-scale platforms (Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury, Revolut Business, Payoneer) routinely decline Vanuatu-domiciled International Companies due to the FATF grey-listing of June 2024, perceived high money-laundering risk of the trust sector, and correspondent-bank de-risking. A licensed VU trustee should treat EMIs only as downstream payment beneficiaries, never as the primary account bank. If digital rails are mandatory for operations, a parallel operating entity in an acceptable clearing jurisdiction should be used solely for treasury flows, with the VU IC remaining the legal owner of the trust assets.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for initial account opening. AMLA/CDD practice under the AML/CFT Act (No. 13 of 2014) requires face-to-face verification of at least the trustee's authorized director and one named signatory at the Port Vila or Luganville branch. Originals of passports, proof of residence, notarized board resolutions, apostilled incorporation documents, and the executed trust deed must be tabled; the settlor and discretionary beneficiaries need not appear when not signatories, but a sealed beneficiary schedule and their certified identity and source-of-funds packs must be lodged. Remote video KYC is accepted only for subsequent account additions, new signatories, or disbursements crediting newly introduced third parties, and only after the in-person baseline is established. No VU bank permits fully remote first-time onboarding of a high-risk discretionary trust.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATF grey-listing (June 2024) and associated mandatory enhanced due diligence on all Vanuatu legal persons
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC trust-license certificate and current TCSP compliance rating; audited or accountant-reviewed trust financial statements; written EDD remediation and transaction-monitoring policy; proof of substance including a physical registered office lease and a resident licensed trust officer; sworn declaration that no regulated financial activity is conducted by the IC except the licensed trust administration; prior bank reference letters covering 24 months; demonstrable tax-information-exchange cooperation history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discretionary beneficiary anonymity or unknown ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized trust deed and current Letter of Wishes; sealed and confidential schedule of all discretionary beneficiaries and remaindermen; protector's identity documents and acceptance; trustee statutory declaration attesting that the structure is not a sham or nominee arrangement; locus-standi letter naming the licensed fiduciary as the sole UBO-identifiable party for regulatory access; confirmation of beneficiary review at each material transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsupported source of wealth/source of funds for the settled corpus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Settlor's bank statements for 36 months; asset-purchase agreements, share certificates, inheritance documents, or financial-settlement instruments tracing the corpus; professional tax and legal opinion letters in the settlor's home jurisdiction; notarized source-of-wealth affidavit; gift-deed and transfer certificates; CRS and FATCA self-certifications of the settlor; independent confirmation that no tax evasion predicate exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large one-off inbound settlement immediately post-incorporation (BoP reporting trigger above VUV 10 million / USD 85,000)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed trust settlement deed; trustee board resolution approving the contribution; remitting bank's source-of-funds certificate; foreign tax clearance or non-domicile/gift exemption evidence; 12-month projected cash-flow and disbursement plan; undertaking to supply beneficiary distribution details in line with AML/CFT obligations; written rationale for settlement timing relative to incorporation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt status misread as a tax-evasion indicator or uncooperative-jurisdiction marker
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC tax-exemption certificate issued under Section 35 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; external legal opinion confirming no Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, or stamp duty applies to the trust; proof of active CRS registration and automatic-exchange participation under the International Tax Compliance Act 2017; confirmation of Global Forum membership and exchange relationships; commitment to demonstrate economic substance and bank-disclosed beneficiary flows on request.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Settlement funding is injected via SWIFT MT103 from the settlor's account to the trustee's VUV or USD account at a licensed Vanuatu bank. The remittance narrative must read 'Settlement of Discretionary Trust (VU IC) – Capital Contribution', with the trust name and settlement deed number. Vanuatu does not operate an official purpose-code registry; the remitter's bank should classify the flow under an international convention code such as 'Gift between family members' or 'Capital transfer – other private' while the receiving bank maps it to BoP 'Capital account – other private transfers' for RBV statistics. Acceptable verification for the receiving bank comprises the notarized settlement deed, trustee resolution, source-of-funds pack, and For full traceability the injected funds must originate from the settlor's personal or wholly-owned treasury account, never from unrelated third parties, and any inbound amount above VUV 10 million will trigger BoP reporting and enhanced EDD verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Beneficiary distributions are cleared through SWIFT MT103 wires in USD, AUD, EUR, or GBP from the trust's Vanuatu bank account to the beneficiary's global bank. Each wire is preceded by (i) a trustee distribution resolution naming the beneficiary and the power exercised; (ii) protector's countersignature if the trust instrument so requires; (iii) re-confirmation of the beneficiary's identity, CDD status, and bank details; (iv) OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions screening at the sending bank and in the correspondent chain (typically ANZ Melbourne, Westpac, or a New York-based USD clearer); and (v) compliance with the trust's 12-month cash-flow plan. For commercial disbursements (atypical for a pure asset-protection trust), Commercial Letters of Credit at sight and documentary collections are obtainable through ANZ or NBV, but their use reclassifies the entity as a higher-risk trading trust and should be avoided. No government exchange-control approval or exit tax applies to outbound trust distributions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu deliverable forward contracts (USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, NZD/VUV, EUR/VUV) offered onshore by ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited and BRED Bank (Vanuatu) Limited with bank-standard tenors up to 12 months
AUD/USD and USD/EUR plain-vanilla foreign-exchange swaps and cross-currency swaps executed under an ISDA or bank master agreement with a licensed onshore or investment-grade offshore counterparty
Vanuatu Vatu FX options and AUD/USD barrier options purchased from an onshore dealer bank; no onshore derivatives-licensing or mandatory clearing requirement applies

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs): not offered on a liquid onshore basis in Vanuatu since the VUV is fully convertible and deliverable; only offshore brokers quote VUV/NDFs at very wide spreads, and their use is not recommended for this trust given the absence of convertibility restriction and the additional counterparty and documentation risk

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Renewal (annual government fee and confirmation of exempt status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Division, through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before the anniversary of incorporation; VFSC practice requires payment and confirmation within the 30-day window preceding each anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a progressive penalty under the VFSC late-fee tariff; continued non-payment for 6 months triggers administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act; struck-off company assets may be forfeited to the Government of Vanuatu, and restoration requires VFSC approval plus payment of all arrears and penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certification of registered office and registered agent continuance for the international company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the same time as the International Company annual renewal, normally 30 days before the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu is a continuing contravention of the International Companies Act; VFSC may suspend the compliance status of the company, impose fines, and ultimately strike the company off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the International Trust Company licence (trustee or fiduciary licence) where the entity acts as a licensed trustee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Trust and Corporate Services Licensing Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the licence anniversary date, or by 31 December if so stated in the VFSC licence conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of the annual licence for an international trust company; continued operation without a valid licence constitutes an offence under the International Trust Companies Act and is subject to fines, director disqualification, and compulsory winding-up.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold exists under the Vanuatu International Companies Act. An independent audit is required only where the VFSC trust-company licence imposes an audit condition or where shareholders or directors resolve to have an audit performed.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act (Cap 222) requires only sufficient books and records to show transactions and financial position; no mandatory accounting framework is prescribed. Where financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS is accepted; VFSC-regulated fiduciary licensees must follow IFRS when audited financial statements are required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone annual UBO confirmation filing is required for Vanuatu International Companies. The VFSC-licensed registered agent must obtain, record, and update beneficial ownership data at the registered office. Any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the UBO register and, where required, reported to VFSC. The registered agent will ordinarily confirm UBO details as part of the annual renewal process.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of members and directors resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 7,000 per engagement if voluntary or regulator-required

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Companies are exempt from all corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and exchange control. No statutory tax holiday or preferential deduction is required because the base tax rate is zero. The International Companies Act 1992, read with the Business Licence Act, authorises licensed fiduciary service providers to administer non-resident trusts with zero direct national taxation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return form. International Companies are not registered for direct tax. The only recurring filing is the VFSC Annual Return / Annual Renewal, submitted via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (VFSC registry renewal); no corporate income tax report is required.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC annual renewal is due on or before the anniversary of incorporation of the International Company. No income tax filing deadline exists because no corporate income tax is imposed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Company Name and IC Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the Vanuatu International Company and VFSC entity number as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered company name. Non-resident shareholders are not required to hold a Vanuatu tax identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed fiduciary service provider acting as registered agent and the registered office location in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Vanuatu-licensed agent is mandatory. Non-resident settlors and trustees may not be listed as the local registered agent or registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full identification of the ultimate beneficial owners, settlor, protector, and beneficiary classes where contractually required by the VFSC electronic form.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident persons must provide full legal name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, and proof of source of funds to the licensed agent. This information is maintained in the confidential beneficial ownership register under AML/CFT law, not as part of a tax return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: There are no corporate income tax late-filing penalties. Failure to file the VFSC annual renewal may attract a daily late surcharge of VUV 500 up to a maximum of VUV 250,000, and can result in striking-off and deregistration under the International Companies Act 1992.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not impose dividend withholding tax or any distribution tax on International Companies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief protocol applies because Vanuatu has not entered into comprehensive double taxation agreements. Dividends, interest, and royalties paid by an International Company are outside Vanuatu's withholding tax net, so no tax treaty relief filing or TRC application is required locally. If foreign tax authorities request proof of Vanuatu non-tax status, the trustee may obtain a letter of certification from the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury, supported by the certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, and a sworn statement of offshore management and control.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: The statutory Vanuatu withholding rate for cross-border royalties and interest is 0%. Because Vanuatu has no applicable double taxation treaties, the treaty rate is effectively 0%; source-country taxes of the paying jurisdiction may nevertheless apply.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A — VUV 0. Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File obligation, and no VUV-denominated documentation threshold. The International Company is outside the domestic tax net; TP compliance may be required solely under the consolidation and audit rules of a foreign parent or beneficiary jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu applies OECD-compliant economic substance rules through the International Companies (Economic Substance) regulations administered by the VFSC. An International Company conducting a relevant activity must demonstrate adequate employees, premises, expenditure, and management and control in Vanuatu. For a discretionary asset-protection trust, the licensed Vanuatu trustee must maintain substantive decision-making records and fiduciary governance; pure passive holding or trust entities may satisfy a reduced economic substance requirement through a local registered agent, registered office, and properly documented trustee meetings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu discretionary asset-protection trust to conceal taxable income or assets from a foreign revenue authority while central management and control remains in a high-tax jurisdiction, or misrepresenting Vanuatu tax residence to obtain treaty benefits not available under any DTA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself imposes no income tax penalty for foreign tax evasion, but the VFSC may deregister an International Company used for unlawful purposes, and foreign authorities may impose accuracy penalties, understatement penalties, and interest. Domestically, fraudulent abuse of corporate and trust forms is punishable under the Penal Code as fraud, with consequential civil recovery orders enforceable by the Vanuatu Supreme Court.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, trustees, and settlors who exercise effective control may be personally assessed in the foreign high-tax jurisdiction if the trust iis disregarded as a sham. Vanuatu mutual legal assistance mechanisms allow asset freezing, travel bans, and extradition; domestic fraud penalties include imprisonment up to seven years and court-ordered restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Administering the discretionary asset-protection trust, exercising trustee discretions, holding settlor funds, or providing trust-management services in or from Vanuatu without a Fiduciary and Trust Companies Act licence issued by the VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Fiduciary and Trust Companies Act 2014, unlicensed fiduciary activity is a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to two years. The VFSC may also strike off the offending International Company and apply for a court order freezing the trust assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners who knowingly participate in unlicensed fiduciary activity are personally liable for the penalty. Courts may pierce the corporate veil, order repayment of all fees received, place a travel ban on responsible officers, and issue management disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to conduct customer due diligence on the settlor, protector, and beneficiaries; failure to maintain an accurate beneficial ownership register; failure to report suspicious transactions to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; or knowingly accepting assets derived from criminal conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2016 and VFSC AML/CFT Rules, corporate penalties may reach VUV 30,000,000; individuals face imprisonment up to 15 years. The VFSC may suspend or revoke the trustee licence and confiscation orders may attach to the entire trust corpus.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, Chief Compliance Officers, and Money Laundering Reporting Officers bear personal criminal and civil liability. Sanctions include imprisonment, disqualification, disgorgement of fees, personal fines up to VUV 10,000,000, travel bans, and freezing orders during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the International Company with no substantive fiduciary decision-making, using nominee directors, maintaining no physical presence or expenditure in Vanuatu, and using the discretionary trust solely as a legal veil for undisclosed foreign ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may deregister the International Company under the International Companies Act 1992 and impose administrative penalties of up to VUV 5,000,000. A false economic-substance declaration triggers additional penalties under the Vanuatu economic substance rules, and trust distributions may be voided as ultra vires or invalid contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may disregard the corporate and trust structure and hold directors personally liable for breach of fiduciary duty, requiring restitution of diverted assets. Directors may be disqualified for up to ten years and face foreign enforcement of civil judgments against their personal estates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Transferring assets into the discretionary asset-protection trust with the settled intention to hinder, delay, or defraud existing or foreseeable creditors while the settlor retains a hidden power to control distributions or revoke the trust.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the common law fraudulent conveyance principles applied in Vanuatu, the transfer may be set aside as void. Foreign courts applying their own voidable-transaction and clawback legislation may enter judgment directly against the trust corpus, and Vanuatu courts will assist in judgment enforcement and asset seizure under international mutual assistance procedures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The settlor, directors, and trustees may be held personally liable to creditors for the value of assets fraudulently transferred, plus punitive damages and interest. Travel bans, contempt orders, and imprisonment may be imposed for refusal to repatriate assets.
